name: Under Armour NCAA Pre-National Invitational
where: Terre Haute, IN · host Indiana State · LaVern Gibson Championship Cross Country Course
headline: Pre-Nationals: No. 1 NC State meets No. 2 BYU
summary: The top two women's teams race each other for the first time this season on the LaVern Gibson course that hosts the NCAA Championships, with No. 7 Notre Dame also in the field. The men's race brings No. 8 Syracuse, No. 14 Villanova, No. 15 Notre Dame and No. 20 Iowa State. BYU's Jane Hedengren is reportedly dealing with illness and will not race.
